note: What a server sends to confirm a unit's spell went up a level. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which slot.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The level the spell now stands at. A client takes any level above 5 as 5.

fields.name: pointsLeft
fields.note: How many spell points are left unspent.

revisions.note: A client handles it the same on every channel: it sets the slot's level and the points left. It does this only for a champion, and nothing for any other unit.
